_comment: Base item rows that are not SRD weapons, armour or magic items. Those come from the addon at load: every SRD weapon and armour by slug (kind weapon / armor / shield) and every SRD magic item by slug (kind from magic.json). Tiles come from data/tiles.json: every breakable tile is an item tile:<name>; tile_drops says what digging a tile gives when it is not itself. Row fields: name, kind (tile, material, consumable, coin, spark, gear), stack (most per slot), value (coin), weight (lb), use (consumables: heal dice), tags.

tile_drops._comment: Digging terrain gives plain rubble (M4: no block types to collect); ore gives an ore trade good; built things (walkways, stairs, ladders, ropes, torches, campfire, bed, shrine) give themselves. Old tile:wood, tile:dirt... items in saves stay valid and placeable.

supplies.name: Supplies
supplies.text: Cord, nails, oil and timber offcuts: makes torches, a campfire, a bed, ladders, walkways, stairs and rope.
